description: On the table there’s a small white square base with several upright rectangular posts, and a separate white block piece lying off to the right. The left hand steadies near the front-left edge of the base while the right hand reaches to the right, grasps the loose block as a right-hand object, lifts it, and places it onto the base at the front-right area, adjusting it upright before releasing and pulling the right hand back.
